name: Niihara Kanako
source:
Second daughter of the Niihara family. The protagonist's immediate older sister. A famous figure at her university, always surrounded by admirers. At home, she's constantly snide and sarcastic, and the worst part is that she doesn't even think she's being mean. Her offhand remarks regularly cut into the protagonist and cause him significant stress.

[From the [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/gaz/en/character.html]official website[/url]]
